about: Curated stops for the Mountain and Northwest legs (Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah; missing roads brief 3, 2026-11-23), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Started from every stop the region's legs already carried with coordinates and a source, copied as they were (their readings and sources kept; the leg mile, exit and approach fields belong to one leg's drive and are left to the placing tool), then added to for the new legs from operator pages and OpenStreetMap. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it.

truck_access.about: Counts for the stops added in the missing roads pass. Read: OpenStreetMap hgv=yes on the services area or an operator page listing truck parking. Assumed: a state rest area on a numbered highway that carries tractor-trailers, with no truck parking tagged. Carried: stops the region's legs already had, copied with their own sources.
